gen-gf-underdog-gf-titillium-web: Expressive and bold, Underdog draws every curve like bent cable, while Titillium Web follows with stroke ends set far apart and a friendlier sans manner. Body text can sit fairly modest beside it.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-tomorrow: Underdog bends its heavy letters at a single thickness, with a horseshoe-shaped c that gapes wide open. And Tomorrow, in a quiet sans-serif, lets its bowls open like a cupped palm, so it can stay small.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-trispace: Trispace reads sparse and widely set, its curves opening outward rather than curling in. Underdog brings the commanding weight with no stress in its curves, and that plain sans spacing gives its loud shapes plenty of room to sit.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Tsukimi Rounded reads soft, with round forms like open parentheses. Underdog is the loud half, a display face with a horseshoe c, and the sans keeps parallel stroke edges that make the gap between them the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-tuffy: A horseshoe-shaped c, opened wide with no shift in stroke weight, is the first thing Underdog gives you. But Tuffy, a sans-serif sketched as if by a pencil that never presses harder, has a widely parted s that keeps the text quiet.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-urbanist: Underdog's curves never swell or thin, and its c gapes open like a horseshoe, which gives the display face real swagger. Urbanist, a sans, trails along in a rolling-ball line; save Underdog for big, short words.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-varela-round: Varela Round frames its counters with same-width strokes and wide-mouthed rounds in the lowercase. Underdog, with its commanding horseshoe c and no weight shift anywhere, takes the shouting, while Varela Round, a plain sans, simply talks.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-varta: Chunky, bent-pipe-cleaner lettering up top. Varta, a sans-serif with big open eyes on every e and a, then carries long reading easily under Underdog's expressive shapes.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-vazirmatn: Vazirmatn has a wide-open s that never tightens. Underdog is best at shouting, with horizontals as thick as its verticals and a horseshoe c, while this sans-serif is best at friendly, modern text.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-wix-madefor-display: Commanding is how Underdog lands, its s spine as thick as its terminals and its c opened like a horseshoe. Wix Madefor Display brings gently flared curve ends that stay apart, and Underdog earns its keep big and short.
